name: std::error_code::default_error_condition
intro:
Returns the default error condition for the current error value.

Equivalent to category().default_error_condition(value()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The default error condition for the current error value.

examples.input: Represent invalid_argument, inspect it, copy it, and clear it. Error messages depend on the implementation.
